c74object.name: el.bvplay~
c74object.digest: Pre-scheduled buffer player with linear interpolation and envelope tapering
c74object.description:
el.bvplay~ provides note-statement-like playback of audio from a buffer. It is useful mainly because it internally applies an envelope to regions of a buffer during playback.
Inlets
Left Inlet (list): Accepts a 4-item note data list formatted as: [start_ms, dur_ms, speed, amp].
Outlets
Left Outlet (signal): Main audio output (Mono) or Left Channel audio output (Stereo).
Second Outlet (signal): Right Channel audio output (Stereo mode only).

objarg.name: buffername
objarg.description: The name of the source buffer~ to read audio samples from.

objarg.name: channel count
objarg.description: Sets the channel count for the object. Supports 1 (Mono output) or 2 (Stereo output).

objarg.name: fade time
objarg.description: Initial fade ramp applied to the beginning and end of each note in milliseconds. Defaults to 10.0 ms if unspecified.

method.name: list
method.digest: Trigger a pre-scheduled note playback segment
method.description: Play a note. The values in the list must contain 4 parameters: [skip_ms, duration_ms, increment, amplitude]. For example, a list of 1000 4000 -0.5 1.0 skips 1 second into the buffer, plays for 4 seconds backwards at half speed with unity gain. It is up to the user to ensure that note lists are sensible with respect to the contents of the buffer. el.bvplay~ is monophonic. Use it inside a poly~ if you need polyphony.

method.name: taper
method.description: Sets the ramp fade time for the envelope tapering in milliseconds.

method.name: verbose
method.description: Turn internal console error messaging on (1) or off (0).

attribute.name: taper
attribute.description: Specifies the envelope fade duration in milliseconds applied to the bounds of the playback note segment. Default value is 10.0 ms.
